create_descriptor_database: create a DescriptorDatabase instance to store and index FileDescriptorProtos by file name and symbol
add_file_descriptor_proto: add a FileDescriptorProto to the database which indexes its messages, enums, extensions, and services
find_file_by_name: find a FileDescriptorProto in the database by its .proto file name path
find_file_containing_symbol: find the FileDescriptorProto that contains a fully qualified symbol like package.Message or package.Message.NestedEnum
extract_symbols_from_descriptor: recursively extract all fully qualified symbol names from a descriptor proto including nested types and enums
